entries.zh: 誊抄、移写（如抄书般照录）；草拟、拟稿
entries.en: to copy out or transcribe (as books are copied); to draft in writing
entries.notes: 闽音栏三音节（chau pia n）对单字“拟”，分解不定，仅凭词头与“拟”字互证。

entries.zh: 誊录成表、开列表册（“平起表”详义存疑）
entries.en: to copy out into a table or list (lit. “ping-qi biao”; sense uncertain)
entries.notes: 末音节 lay 与“表”字音不合，中字声调污损难辨，词义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 拟写禀白、起草书信文牍；誊录信件
entries.en: to draft a letter or written statement; to transcribe a letter
entries.notes: 西语词头“la carta conta”拼写残误（当作 cuenta），“白”取禀白义。

entries.zh: 抄写、誊写；拟稿撰写
entries.en: to copy out, transcribe; to write out a draft

entries.zh: 法帖（供临摹习字的碑帖摹本）；照帖摹写
entries.en: calligraphy model book (copybook); to copy after it in practicing writing

entries.zh: 坐眠（坐着过夜打盹）；守夜、熬夜过夜
entries.en: to spend the night sitting up; to keep vigil, stay up through the night

entries.zh: 失、失却；此条指失（眠），熬夜不睡
entries.en: to lose; here: to lose (one's sleep), to miss a night's sleep
entries.notes: 汉栏仅单字“失”，“失眠”义由同组“失精神”“无眠”及词头 trasnochar 推断。

entries.zh: 失神、精神萎顿；熬夜失神，元气亏损
entries.en: to lose one's spirit or vigor; to be spent, dispirited

entries.zh: 无眠、失眠，彻夜不睡
entries.en: to be sleepless; to pass the night without sleeping

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: translucent (letting light pass through), resplendent, shining
entries.notes: 汉、闽、官话三栏皆空，仅存西语词头，中文对应无从判断。

entries.zh: 透、穿透；透过、渗过
entries.en: to pass through; to pierce, penetrate through

entries.zh: 通、通过；贯通、穿行
entries.en: to pass or cross through; to go through

entries.zh: 累、拖累；谓亚当之罪累及后人，原罪传代
entries.en: to implicate, encumber; (of the guilt from Adam) to pass guilt down to posterity

entries.zh: 拨、转拨；把债务或款项移拨他人
entries.en: to transfer, assign over (a debt); to shift (funds, obligation) to another

entries.zh: 捡、拾取；或取接拾、承拾（他人债务）义，详义存疑
entries.en: to pick up; here possibly to take over (a debt), sense uncertain
entries.notes: “捡”字常音与音写 quiau 不合，与“转让债务”义亦不契。

entries.zh: 献、呈献；置于“转让债务”条下，或取献纳、交呈义
entries.en: to offer up, present (as tribute); to hand over
entries.notes: “献”与“转让债务”搭配偏间接，献纳、交呈义属推断。

entries.zh: 越、违越；越犯法度，干犯、破坏法律
entries.en: to transgress, exceed; to break the law
entries.notes: 闽音栏残缺；义据“越”字与词头（越法犯法）相合，按残缺规程降为低置信。

entries.zh: 所累（为…所累）；因罪受累、被拖累
entries.en: to be implicated or burdened (by guilt passed on)
entries.notes: 音写 hou 与“所”字常音不合，然汉栏“所累”与词头移罪累人之义互证可通。

entries.zh: 连累、牵连；把罪责牵累及他人
entries.en: to implicate, drag another in; to involve someone in blame

entries.zh: 累及、波及；罪责牵连而及于人
entries.en: to extend to, implicate; (of guilt) to spread to others
